title: Reolink Night Bitrate Under-Run
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reolink:event event=stream_health
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=20 OR hour<6
| stats avg(bitrate_mbps) as avg_bitrate_mbps, min(bitrate_mbps) as min_bitrate_mbps by camera
| where avg_bitrate_mbps<2 OR min_bitrate_mbps<1
| sort avg_bitrate_mbps
description: Uses Reolink stream bitrate telemetry to monitor how much bitrate drops at night when scenes get harder in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cameras that may be under-recording critical night detail, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Reolink stream bitrate data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how much bitrate drops at night when scenes get harder so you can spot cameras that may be under-recording critical night detail before it becomes annoying.
